title: Tangent measures via (DTC): localized blow-ups of the weight of a minimizing cycle subconverge vaguely to the weight of a minimizing cone cycle with homogeneous density (parent steps 4(e), 5 with (F4), (F5), (F7), (F8))
statement: Assume (DTC). (DTC) is the contract proposition DensityAndTangentCones (Simon 7.3.1): for n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅ and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N: (1) there is Θ with HasMassDensity T x (Θ x) on U ∖ spt ∂T, upper semicontinuous there; (2) for every x ∈ spt T ∖ boundarySupport T and every sequence λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0 there are a strictly increasing φ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) with blowUp T x λ_{φ(j)} ⇀ C (ConvergesWeakly), MassMeasuresConverge for these blow-ups and C, IsMinimizingIn C univ, IsConeCurrent C, and a common density θ of T at x and of C at 0. For a measure ν on ℝ^{n+k}, a point a and s > 0 write ν^{a,s} := ofReal(s^{−n})•ν.map(dilation a s), and r_ν(w, ρ) := ν(B_ρ(w))/(unitBallVolume n·ofReal(ρ^n)). (A) Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, U, N, G ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with U and G open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U, R an IMRep of T in U, p ∈ U with p ∈ G, and λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0. Then there are a strictly increasing sub : ℕ → ℕ, a current C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} with ∂C = 0, and an IMRep R_C of C in ℝ^{n+k} such that, with μ_C := R_C.measure, limsup_{ρ→0⁺} r_{μ_C}(t·w, ρ) = limsup_{ρ→0⁺} r_{μ_C}(w, ρ) for all t > 0 and w, and ∫ f d(R.measure⌞G)^{p,λ_{sub(j)}} → ∫ f dμ_C for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ. (B) For n, k ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} with ∂S = 0, every IMRep R of S in ℝ^{n+k}, every y ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and every λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0, the same conclusion holds with (R.measure)^{y,λ_{sub(j)}} in place of (R.measure⌞G)^{p,λ_{sub(j)}}.
